label: post-hoc, v2's own calibrator was fit on this same 2015 data (calibration, not model selection), so 2015 is not a clean holdout for v2 the way it was for v1
note: Calibration (v2's Platt scaling, fit on 2015) is a monotone transform of the raw booster score, so it does not change AUC, Gini, or KS - these metrics are identical whether scored with or without the calibrator applied. v1's score (pd_lightgbm) and target come from the already-saved, one-time test_scored.parquet; v2 is scored fresh here with its own saved artifacts (reports/metrics/frozen_model_config.json's lightgbm_chosen).
